create.name: Torsten Lange
create.bio:
Torsten A. Lange holds a singular distinction in his field: he is the only Hay House author for reiki — the practice’s sole representative at the world’s largest mind-body-spirit publisher. Founder and director of The Reiki Academy in London, he came to healing the way many of the great teachers do: through collapse. A successful businessman whose life fell apart, he credits reiki with saving his life and bringing it back on track — and he has spent the decades since repaying that debt, teaching thousands of students worldwide and conducting some of the field’s most dedicated research into reiki’s history and spiritual foundations, including material found in no other book.

That research became “Reiki Made Easy” (Hay House, 2018), his bestselling and widely translated introduction to the healing system, followed by the more daring “Proof of Reiki, Proof of Eternity” and “There Is a Way: The Reiki Revolution” — works that carry his deeper fascination with what reiki reveals about consciousness beyond the body. A trained Past Life Regression Therapist who also studied mediumship to professional level at London’s historic College of Psychic Studies, Torsten teaches alongside a faculty of senior teachers at his Barnes academy (including the Chair of the UK Reiki Federation), hosts his fortnightly Reiki Revolution LIVE show on YouTube, and speaks internationally. Warm, rigorous, and quietly revolutionary, he is British reiki’s great ambassador — the man carrying the practice toward both the mainstream and the mysteries.

books.title: Reiki Made Easy: Heal Your Body and Your Life with the Power of Universal Energy
books.author: Torsten A. Lange
books.description: Torsten's bestselling Hay House guide is a warm, practical way into reiki, from its Japanese origins to giving treatments to yourself and others. It includes simple exercises, meditations and energy-cleansing techniques. It shows that reiki is for everyone and can change both body and life.

books.title: Proof of Reiki, Proof of Eternity: Discover the Hidden Dimension of Reiki - And Find Answers to Life's Biggest Questions
books.author: Torsten A. Lange
books.description: At 35, Torsten was bankrupt and had lost his home, and then reiki entered his life and turned everything around. This book follows his search for why it works, through quantum physics, past lives and Japanese history, including guidance he says came from Mikao Usui as a spirit guide. It presents reiki as a way of life rather than simply an energy therapy.

books.title: There is a Way: The Reiki Revolution
books.author: Torsten A. Lange
books.description: This is Torsten's call for personal and collective transformation. It offers a step-by-step programme of exercises for rewiring the subconscious and moving from fear to love, with reiki at its heart. The aim is change that begins with the individual and spreads to families, communities and the world.

courses.title: Reiki 1
courses.description: A two-day foundation course covering reiki's history, philosophy and practice. It includes four attunements, the 12 classic hand positions, self-treatment and treating others, and students are giving short treatments by the first day. It comes with a printed manual, lifelong online campus access and a professional certificate.

courses.title: Reiki 2
courses.description: A two-day advanced course that introduces the reiki symbols and distant healing and prepares students for professional practice. It also deepens personal spiritual development.

courses.title: Professional Reiki Practitioner Diploma
courses.description: A modular, accredited training taken over at least nine months, which qualifies graduates to join the CNHC register and work in NHS and charity settings. It is made up of Reiki 1 and 2, four workshops, three Reiki Shares, treatment journals, case studies and a final exam.
courses.price: £1,048 GBP in total, paid per module

courses.title: Reiki Master Training (Shinpiden)
courses.description: A five-day residential immersion in the complete reiki system with Torsten, covering master symbols and attunements, advanced Japanese techniques and higher-consciousness practice. It runs in Glastonbury from 12–16 Apr 2027 and in London from 22–26 Aug 2027.
courses.price: From £1,247 GBP (London early bird before 31 Dec 2026); Glastonbury from £1,297 GBP

courses.title: Professional Reiki Practice
courses.description: A one-day workshop based on the National Occupational Standards for reiki. It covers client records, confidentiality, insurance, legal requirements, and marketing a practice. It is a diploma module and a prerequisite for CNHC registration.

courses.title: Treatment Day
courses.description: A practical day on delivering professional reiki sessions, from client interviews and consent to tailoring treatments and writing case studies. It includes four full treatments.

courses.title: Past Life Regression (Exploring Past Lives)
courses.description: An introductory one-day workshop on reincarnation and past-life regression, including a guided meditation to meet your spirit guide and regression exercises in pairs and groups. It is open to everyone and needs no prior experience.

courses.title: Complete Reiki 1 Online Certification Course (Reiki in 8 Hours)
courses.description: A video course with Torsten covering reiki history and treating yourself and others. It includes four distant attunements and a certificate, and works on any device.

courses.title: Complete Reiki Practitioner Certification Course
courses.description: Reiki 1 and 2 combined into one programme of 72 video lessons (more than 14 hours) with downloads and step-by-step guides, aimed at professional practice.

courses.title: ReikiScience® Practitioner Training Course
courses.description: Torsten's own system, based on his research into reiki's Japanese origins, which links the symbols to the three tanden energy centres. It includes a special attunement.

courses.title: Stepping Into Consciousness: ReikiScience® Master Training
courses.description: An advanced master-level programme built on the Reiki Master symbol, which takes ReikiScience into deeper consciousness work.

courses.title: Reiki Made Easy (Hay House online course)
courses.description: A six-lesson online course with Torsten, published by Hay House. It covers reiki's origins, breathing and meditation, energy cleansing, treatments, symbols and chants, with video lessons, audio meditations and worksheets.
